blurb: Guests take helicopter tours over the Emerald Coast, including Panama City Beach, 30A, Shell Island, and St. Andrews State Park. Tours range from 3 to 22 minutes, offering views of beaches, marine life, and local landmarks. Custom and photo flights are available, with a focus on safety and enjoyment.
extraNote: Tours operate 10am to sunset, 7 days a week, weather permitting · Flight may be cancelled due to rain, lightning, fog, or high winds · Single riders can pay for 2 seats with $5 discount per seat, join single rider list, or wait for pairing · Military discount $5 off first 4 tours, $10 off 3 most expensive tours with valid ID · Brand new facility in Panama City Beach, FL
